create_uma_finetune_dataset: run the CLI script to create a UMA finetuning dataset from ASE atoms directories with energy or force regression tasks
create_yaml_config: create YAML configuration files for UMA model finetuning with dataset paths, normalizer RMSD, and linear reference coefficients
launch_processing_train_val: launch parallel processing of ASE atoms objects from train and val directories into the output directory
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute the force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from processed training data for UMA finetuning
run_uma_finetuning: run UMA model finetuning using the generated YAML config with fairchem -c pointing to the uma_sm_finetune_template.yaml file
